items.text: Siloam Springs: Learning more about the Panther Health and Wellness Clinic, which is based at the @Siloam_Panthers Intermediate School. The PHWC is 1 of 7 school-based clinics operated by @CClinicNWA, and they offer an array of services and care for students and the community. https://t.co/wj7lzH2nv6

It’s unthinkable knowing families are struggling to find formula. There is no time to waste in addressing this crisis and ensuring this vital source of nutrition is readily available. It's why I'm supporting the Formula Act alongside @RepBice @RepFeenstra. https://t.co/I2WRLqg9Ss https://t.co/0cQoU0lllF

I'm proud to vote to pass the Keep Kids Fed Act. The bill responsibly extends access to affordable meals and nutrition to students across the country. As inflation and supply chain issues continue to burden communities, this legislation will bring certainty to those in dire need.

I also visited the new Walmart Health Center in Rogers. The facility is a one-stop shop for Arkansans. It offers primary and urgent medical care, as well as dental, optometry, and other health services. Their comprehensive approach is all about improving overall #AR3 wellness. https://t.co/zk0qcPaLId

Around #AR3: Dropped by the Adult Wellness Center in Rogers to say hello to some of my fellow Arkansans and check out the latest at the facility! The center and its staff have such a great impact on our community. @Rogers1881 https://t.co/cb6m0hbTXC

Around #AR3: Strong medical care is fundamental to the health and well-being of Arkansans. Hospitals are a vital piece of that mission. I visited with Eureka Springs Mayor Butch Berry to hear more about plans to expand and renovate Eureka Springs Hospital. https://t.co/xFeU7pTodP

We also discussed local work that helped restore the West Fork of the White River, land conservation at Mill Branch Park in Goshen, source water protection, and treatment intake & capacity. Arkansans are prepared to be good stewards of our land and water now and into the future. https://t.co/UaHGKgOUt3

#AR3 in DC: Talking to Dr. Scott Cooper of Bentonville about healthcare and medical work in the Third District. We also discussed my cosponsorship of the Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act. The bill will ensure patients receive timely access to critical health services. https://t.co/C5fjIhAWBy

A cancer diagnosis is a life-changing moment. Medical research will be key to developing future cures, and there are so many #AR3 advocates working to support patients. Thank you @DanyelleSargent, Sheila Staten of Rogers, and @AmericanCancer for your work on behalf of Arkansas! https://t.co/KObDFTCtpH

Millions of survivors are affected by lymphedema as a result of their fight against cancer. It's important that those suffering from this illness have the treatment resources they need. It's why I cosponsored & just voted to pass the #LymphedemaTreatmentAct to increase coverage.

JUST PASSED → The CAROL Act will help scientists and researchers improve their understanding of valvular heart disease and care for patients. As a cosponsor, I'm proud to support legislation that will provide tools to better diagnose and treat this disease. It will save lives.

⚠️Weather Alert⚠️ Severe weather is expected throughout Arkansas. Please be cautious of the winter storm and accumulating ice. Icy roads and downed trees and power lines continue to be major concerns.  Follow news updates and exercise caution if traveling. https://t.co/SILl6xpxz1

The word "cancer" is life-altering. Supporting patients and their families from screening and diagnosis to treatment is the mission of Highlands Oncology. Their work of providing personalized, compassionate, and specialized care is critical to the health infrastructure of #AR3. https://t.co/uvWm3cMR9U

Giving back is part of the fabric of #AR3. Good Samaritan Clinic in Fort Smith is dedicated to serving those in need. Their medical team, which offers an array of services and care, is made of volunteers. They have supported the health and wellness of Arkansans for two decades! https://t.co/xIBPbbGAdj

The Guidance Center serves those suffering from mental health and substance abuse disorders or faced with other obstacles. They connect people with the treatment they need to change their lives. Felicia Lyons and her team are dedicated to helping people through difficult times. https://t.co/Rv9vbiNa5K

I had the privilege this morning to speak at the Quilts of Valor ceremony at Rogers Adult Wellness Center to honor #AR3 veterans.

We will never forget their dedication to our nation. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/VvhQHjwUSJ

I hate to hear of the Leader’s medical diagnosis, but one thing is certain—@SteveScalise is a fighter. I am confident he will battle this cancer with the same spirit as he did following the shooting in 2017. He has the conference’s unwavering support, just like before.

In honor of National Salute to Veteran Patients Week, my team gave Valentine’s Day cards and a letter from me to veterans at the VA Medical Center in Fayetteville thanking them for their service.

Proud to see #A3 paying tribute to America’s heroes. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/GqAZPuyAic

This week, I met with Arkansans in the medical field about ways to work together to promote the health and well-being of patients in the Natural State and across the country.

I'm proud of the incredible work being done in #AR3 to care for our community. Thank you to the folks at @Commpharmacy, @AOAConnect, and @AOAforDOs for the visits!

Click below for USDA Food and Nutrition Service’s disaster assistance page. FNS coordinates with state, territory, tribal, and voluntary organizations to provide nutrition assistance to families and people affected by a disaster or emergency.
https://t.co/E9CNMiaGGU

Folks from #AR3 representing the International Fresh Produce Association recently came by to discuss the Farm Bill, support for specialty crops, and improving nutrition standards in SNAP. I’m grateful to be a partner in their work to advocate for farmers and businesses across America.

I recently joined my @HouseAppropsGOP colleagues on a CODEL to Hawaii to assess US defense capabilities and oversee the RIMPAC 2024 exercise. I’m extremely proud to see our military strengthening bonds across the Pacific. 

Ran into some Arkansans while I was there! AN Jhalon Finley is serving aboard the USS Carl Vinson and Sara Rupe is a 5th grade teacher at Marine Corps Base Hawaii!

Today, @HouseVetAffairs considered my bill, the Protecting Veteran Access to Telemedicine Services Act, which ensures our nation's veterans have uninterrupted access to healthcare services by permanently extending care right to their homes. 

Read more: https://t.co/1DAL15Xzei https://t.co/tA6vGzRCvm

#AR3 is home to fantastic doctors across all medical fields, and Dr. Sandy Johnson is a shining example of one of our talented doctors. 

Dr. Johnson is a dermatologist in Greenwood, and she came by this week to talk about Medicare reimbursement and patient access to care. Thank you for the visit!

I have continuously supported cancer research funding throughout my time in Congress. Arkansans with the @ACSCAN discussed legislation that would allow for Medicare coverage for multi-cancer early detection screening tests that are approved by the FDA—a bill I strongly support. Hopefully, providing seniors with access to early detection will catch cancers before a late-stage diagnosis and save lives.
